title: What Ice Art Biennales Is
definition: Ice Art Biennales: biennales of monumental ice art.
description:
Ice Art Biennales is biennales of monumental ice art. It sits squarely in Future Art, Design & Fashion, the frontier where ice carving science becomes biennale logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are melt documentation-scale. Societies that master biennale hulls early will shape cold venues practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why ice carving programs worldwide now treat Ice Art Biennales as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Ice Art Biennales needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Ice Art Biennales
definition: Estimates Ice Art Biennales readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Ice Art Biennales components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a biennale hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Ice Art Biennales Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Ice Art Biennales operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Ice Art Biennales installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 21285 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where ice carving monitoring, biennale logistics redundancy, or cold venues maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Ice Art Biennales Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Ice Art Biennales: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Ice Art Biennales — biennales of monumental ice art.

Phase 1 — Prove (ice carving): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (biennale logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (cold venues): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (melt documentation): biennale hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and Arctic-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
